rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance – housing discrimination ban including source of income
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents may not discriminate in renting, viewing, or the terms and conditions of tenancy based on protected categories, including source of income (Section 8 and public benefits). Applicants may be selected using any reasonable standard, such as ability to pay rent, if it is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing transactions in the City of Cambridge, including viewing or renting an apartment and the terms and conditions of tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Two-family dwellings where the owner lives in the building.
rules.penalty: After a hearing the Commission may file a criminal complaint, levy civil fines of up to $300 per violation, seek injunctive relief, and seek damages, expenses and other relief. Either party may remove a fair housing case to Superior Court or the Attorney General's Office.
rules.citation: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance, Cambridge Municipal Code ch. 14.04
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
rules.conflict_note: This is a summary page from the Human Rights Commission. The ordinance text and its effective date are not given. The page lists other protected categories as well (race, disability, family status, etc.).
